findings.finding: Recovery session is a local variable while original #session and #terminated remain authoritative. An unconfirmed recovery stop can therefore be skipped by terminate and another cleanup can start another child.
findings.required: Track actual current recovery ownership before initialization, gate replacement on that session confirmation, and prove refusal for both current/replacement close and drain failures.

findings.finding: Fixed aggregate message hides original cleanup and stop details in final Runner cleanupErrors strings; wrapper-level nested-cause assertion alone does not prove production output visibility.
findings.required: Preserve both error details in final result within existing contract, retain nested immediate-boundary identity, assert both via actual Runner result.

findings.finding: V1 lacks planned actual Loader refusal negatives for unconfirmed close/drain.
findings.required: Add real current and replacement Loader cases; unchanged child count and preserved snapshot, existing deadlines.

acceptedParts: Explicit session close-plus-drain confirmation distinct from signal failure
Catch awaits helper before finally, preserving cleanup context lifecycle
Normal same-session success separated from explicit real replacement scenarios
Execute-error IPC marker separately asserted from final Core cleanup-priority summary
